cards.intuition: A random surfer follows links most of the time and teleports sometimes. Important pages pass divided probability to their targets.

cards.intuition: It measures prominence in the observed graph, not query match or truth. Fuse it cautiously with relevance and source evidence.

cards.intuition: Scope, missing links, template edges, age, and manipulation shape rank. Version the snapshot and inspect top results.

cards.intuition: Combine thin unique content, repetition, affiliate density, hidden text, duplicate clusters, and suspicious links because each feature has legitimate exceptions.
cards.formula: page + host + graph features → calibrated quality decision

cards.intuition: Hard-reject clear threats, downrank probable junk, quarantine uncertain high-impact cases, and sample accepted and rejected content.
cards.formula: risk and confidence determine reject, downrank, or review

cards.intuition: Choose the authoritative, complete, stable, current, well-extracted, permitted copy while retaining alternate membership and evidence.
cards.formula: cluster → one serving representative + reversible member lineage

cards.intuition: Same bytes, same work, same claim, and same current serving content are different equivalence relations. Legal archives and current RAG retain differently.
cards.formula: similarity threshold implements policy; it does not define policy
cards.topic: Corpus-Level Dedup Policy: What to Keep and What to Drop

cards.intuition: Copies monopolize top ranks, inflate evaluation, and make one evidence lineage look independently corroborated.
cards.formula: collapse copies before embedding and context selection
cards.topic: Corpus-Level Dedup Policy: What to Keep and What to Drop

cards.intuition: Official docs fit product limits; primary studies fit original experiments; community reports fit lived experience. No source owns every domain.

cards.intuition: Track provenance, primary status, editorial process, evidence, currency, independence, and correction history separately.
cards.topic: Source Credibility Signals for a Research Corpus

cards.intuition: Five copies of one release are one lineage. Use duplicate clusters, shared wording, timing, and citations to detect dependence.
cards.formula: corroboration counts independent evidence lineages, not URLs

cards.intuition: Citations and source labels let users inspect evidence. When strong sources conflict, show the disagreement and effective dates.
cards.formula: calibrated trust requires visible evidence and uncertainty
